mentions.name: Deadlog
mentions.description: A changelog archive for the video game Deadlock, used as a test project for the Mog markup language; per-change classifications such as buffs and nerfs are stored as Mog attributes directly alongside the change text.
mentions.source_excerpt: One project I'm using to test the language is https://deadlog.io, a changelog archive for Deadlock (my favorite video game). Using Mog attributes, I store classifications generated by JEV for each change, such as buffs and nerfs, directly alongside the change text.
mentions.author: bottd
